definitions.explanation: An interest rate expressed on a per-year basis. The standard unit for advertising loan and deposit rates in Japan.

examples.japanese: {年利|ねんり}1パーセントで{借|か}りた。
examples.english: I borrowed at one percent annual interest.

examples.japanese: この{定期預金|ていきよきん}は{年利|ねんり}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This fixed-term deposit has a high annual interest rate.

examples.japanese: カードローンは{年利|ねんり}が{高|たか}いので{気|き}をつけたほうがいい。
examples.english: Card loans have high annual interest, so you should be careful.

notes:
Compound of {年|ねん} (year) + {利|り} (interest; profit). The default time unit for quoting interest rates in everyday Japanese finance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年利|ねんり}{換算|かんさん}: annualized rate
- {年利|ねんり}が{高|たか}い / {低|ひく}い: high / low annual interest
- {年利|ねんり}{固定|こてい}: fixed annual rate
- {実質|じっしつ}{年利|ねんり}: real (after-fee) annual interest rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {月利|げつり}: monthly interest rate — used mainly for short-term consumer credit
- {利率|りりつ}: interest rate (general term, time unit unspecified)
- {金利|きんり}: interest rate; finance charge — broader, often used for loans and deposits without specifying the period
